rows.text: The party's record headed 小泉総裁再任挨拶 and dated 平成１３年８月１０日 has 小泉総裁 thank the members for their unanimous recommendation (満場一致のご推挙) and nomination as LDP president, describe it as confidence given without objection in the party presidential election held just after the national vote, and say that the ministers and the party and Diet officers would basically stay as they were (基本的に現体制で臨んでいきたい).
